name: assistant-code-block
opens_with: (agent script only — no keystroke opens it)
notes: The ONLY scenario that renders a fenced code block, so it is the falsifier for the syntax path. MEASURED 2026-11-14: without it, 26 of 49 tokens in a realistic Rust function kept syntect's pinned base16-ocean.dark colour instead of taking an operant role, and the whole 67-scenario corpus stayed green because no other scenario ever called highlight_code. The needle tokens are chosen so a regression names itself: `pub`, `fn`, `let` and `u16` are the four that a comma-joined selector fails to match (they resolve to storage.type / storage.modifier scopes), while `if`, `return` and the numbers already matched via keyword.control and constant.numeric. If this golden drifts, check SYNTAX_SELECTORS in markdown_render_support.rs first: ScopeStack::from_str parses "a, b, c" as ONE three-atom sequence containing a literal comma, so every comma-joined entry matches nothing unless it is split.
